summary.text: James Teeple is a Republican businessman and U.S. Navy veteran who has represented District 116 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 11, 2024, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Clay N. Middleton is also on the general election ballot for the seat.

paragraphs.text: James Teeple served in the U.S. Navy, and his career experience includes work as a businessman.
He succeeded Matthew Leber as the District 116 representative and is assigned to the Education and Public Works Committee for 2025-2026.
